shared_elements: upright stone slab/monolith with a rounded, shaped upper end
carved/incised decoration covering the whole face
broad horizontal band dividing the surface into an upper and a lower zone
repeated parallel incised lines forming a border-like row
curved, arcing linear motifs flanking a vertical axis
roughly bilateral symmetry about a central axis
justification: Both are tall, upright carved stones with a narrowed rounded top, roughly symmetrical decoration and a horizontal division separating an upper zone from a lower zone containing curved motifs and a circular element, which gives a comparable first-glance silhouette. The rendering differs entirely: A is a dense, fine-lined engraving of narrative figures, animals and ribbon interlace framed by rows of small marks, whereas B is a massive, sparse, low-relief block whose few broad grooves suggest a schematic body rather than any scene.
